resources.string: Use both rows for the current lyric (about 12 CJK characters per row). Longer lyrics pause before changing pages within the lyric timing. No horizontal scrolling.
Resume Spotify when Android Auto connects
Once the car connects and Music Auto is ready, resume Spotify once. Pausing will keep it paused until the next connection.
Open Spotify on your phone and start a song, then select Music Auto again.
Follow only Spotify, including while paused. The native-player filter does not apply in this mode. Start playback in Spotify on your phone first. Android Auto still chooses which player is shown.
